data.name: Mabrukah
data.gender_notes: Mabrukah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'abrk', which means 'to bless'. In Islamic tradition, the name Mabrukah is given to a child as a blessing, expressing hope for a life of success and good fortune. The name Mabrukah carries the meaning “Congratulations, blessed” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mabrukah usually hope their child will grow to embody congratulations, blessed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes blessings from Allah and encourages the bearer to strive for spiritual growth and success in their life.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mabrukah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
